common.original_data: Complete original EventClassificationData_4C processed X/y representation, all40 sessions/allHW rows/all40bins perunit. Training labels are phase-specific; full labels, original label-revealing source order and rat/session joins stay evaluator-owned.
common.support: All 40 source sessions, all label-3/4 HW rows, all units × 40 peri-event bins, all five OOF folds, both class recalls, per-session balanced accuracy, complete probabilities and source-shuffle companions. Historical unseeded shuffle 0.5162 and newly seeded engineering controls remain separately labelled.
common.split: Author code specifies within-session StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=622), each original HW row held out once. Preserve seed 622, source row ordering and the original stratification protocol. Authenticate inputs and record package/version provenance when regenerating folds; a documented source-conformant rerun with paired candidate-author folds and predeclared justified calibration tolerance does not require an archived historical membership file. Animal/episode/time-based holdouts change the task.
common.preprocessing: Preserve source whole-session standardized, Gaussian-smoothed peri-event features and clipping to [-5,5]; BernoulliNB binarizes at zero. Whole-session normalization and symmetric smoothing remain disclosed; training-only preprocessing cannot undo this original transductive representation.
common.metric: Balanced accuracy per session = 0.5*(avoidance recall + escape recall), after pooling all five out-of-fold predictions and thresholding escape probability at >=0.5. Do not average fold accuracies or substitute probability reconstruction error.
common.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of complete session balanced accuracies across all 40 original sessions; the author batch routine computes the mean of its per-session HW accuracies. Session weighting and animal-level uncertainty are distinct.
common.permitted_observations: Only phase-appropriate training labels within the original outer fold; test labels and label-revealing class-block row order/indices are evaluator-only. Source whole-session normalization, symmetric smoothing and post-event information remain disclosed. Private row presentation must preserve original fold identities while removing target-revealing order.
